About the Clinical Specialty event

Clinical Specialty is a Health Professions event in the HOSA secondary division. Format: skills · speech & presentation · online submission.

Ten in-depth lessons that walk through every Clinical Specialty product in the order you will build it: choosing an eligible health career and skill, researching the career, interviewing a professional, job shadowing, writing the skill checklist, formatting the portfolio, recording the skill video and delivering the five-minute presentation. Each lesson maps directly to the 155-point rating sheets. Always follow the current HOSA guidelines.
